text:
Maya Chen: Quick weekly check for Acme (renewal Sept). Model rollout 2.1 started Tue. New model adoption stalled; fallback rate spiked. Dashboard: https://redwood/dashboards/acme

Lina Park: Numbers — adoption for model-2.1 dropped 48% -> 29% WoW on user-facing routes.

Lina Park: Fallback to model-1.9 increased 2.1% -> 7.8% (peak Wed 14:12 UTC). P95 latency for model-2.1 +42ms vs baseline.

cs-ops-bot: Alert: fallback-rate spike detected for Acme (model-2.1) — 7.8% (threshold 3%), opened INC-4521.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2.1.3 -> canary 30% (rolled Wed 03:40 UTC) by @ravi

Ravi Singh: I raised the canary to 30% on Wed per the rollout playbook. We also enabled the quantized variant for GC-heavy routes.

Jon Perez: Renewal risk? Acme is on the fence. Any customer-facing impact or billing spikes?

Lina Park: Cost per 1k tokens up 14% for model-2.1 because of longer decoded sequences and more retries on errors. Error-rate (5xx) up from 0.4% -> 1.3%.

Maya Chen: Action proposal: 1) Rollback canary to 15% on high-traffic routes; 2) Disable auto-fallback for a subset of routes to triage; 3) Run prompt-level A/B to see degree of quality drop. Volunteers?

Ravi Singh: I'll run infra traces and batch profiling this afternoon. I'll post a heap/profile link.

Lina Park: I'll spin up a short experiment: disable auto-fallback for /generate-chat for 6 hours and capture mismatch set. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/routes/config -d '{"route":"/generate-chat","auto_fallback":false}'
```

Maya Chen: Jon — let's book enablement + review with Acme for Tue 11:00am PT. I'll include a short summary and rollback ops runbook.

Jon Perez: Scheduled. I'll flag renewal SLA to sales leadership; we should propose a temporary dedicated capacity option if spikes continue.

Maya Chen: Owners: Rollback (Ravi), Triage experiment (Lina), Customer comms + meeting (Jon + Maya). Follow-up thread after initial 6h run. :thumbsup:
